summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GOLFGATE Catalunya landing page. All P0 and P1 features verified working: QuickView modal (max-w-md), card flip animation (1.2s delay), Google Maps links (using full_address), footer with logo + contact info, navbar with weather badge showing Barcelona, Swedish language option, and admin panel at /admin.

homepage.details: 20 course cards in 3-column grid, navbar with logo/links/weather/language/admin/CTA

navbar.details: Logo, Courses/About/Contact links, weather badge (14°C Barcelona), language dropdown (EN/ES/CA/DE/FR/SE), settings gear icon (/admin), Book a Tee Time CTA

language_dropdown.details: 6 languages: English, Espanol, Catala, Deutsch, Francais, Svenska (SE)

card_flip_animation.details: 1.2s hover delay before flip, 0.8s transition - verified in CSS and visually

quickview_modal.details: max-w-md (compact), h-44 image height, shows course details and booking button

footer.details: Inverted logo (brightness-0 invert), contact info (phone, email: contact@golfgatecatalunya.es, Barcelona Catalunya), social icons (Facebook, Instagram, X), bottom bar (golfgatecatalunya.es, Privacy Policy, Terms)

admin_panel.details: Course Cards tab shows 21 courses with thumbnails, name, location, holes, price, active/hidden toggle, edit button. Blog Posts tab shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder

admin_edit.details: Clicking Edit shows inline editing fields with Save/Cancel buttons

google_maps_links.details: Links use course.full_address (e.g., 'Camiral Golf & Wellness, Carretera N-II Km 701, 17455 Caldes de Malavella, Girona, Spain') - not generic addresses

GET /api/catalunya-courses.details: Returns 20 active courses with required fields

GET /api/catalunya-courses/camiral-stadi.details: Returns single course with correct data
